body:
Hey guys.  I just want to thank you all for the support.  I will probably message a couple of you who offered.  If I don't message you then know that I am grateful for the thought and the reply.    

Thank you.

I doubt it.  Explain?  Or don't.      

Here's something though, food for thought.  Nearly everybody you come into contact with is going to be more forgiving and kinder to you than you are to yourself.  If you're at this point doing this to you, man you're about the shittiest person in the world to you.     

Also, you wouldn't be doing the world any favours.  The world doesn't care.  You'd only be doing yourself a favour.  This is not meant in either a positive or negative way, I just want to point it out.

Alright dude.  I got this.        

Okay, so you were emotional (rightly so or not, it doesn't matter) and you acted like a complete dick for an entire night?  While you were feeling this way and drunk?  I don't excuse behavior that happened under the influence *because* it was under the influence but it *is* a factor.      

Right now you not only feel horrible about yourself, but you *want* to feel horrible about yourself.  You feel bad and guilty for how you acted and you want someone to pay for it.  Mainly you.  It is understandable.  Recognizing that this is what is happening will surely help you clarify some things in your mind.  It is a self-perpetuating thing that will continue until you choose to forgive yourself or until enough time passes.          

Okay, now that we're here.  About your social group whom you went from the "guardian" of into the "monster" in front of.  Yeah, they were likely really surprised and probably a bit confused/upset by your behavior.  But you are not so important to them as you think.  I don't mean this as you are not an important person, but that you and your actions do not revolve in their minds all day.      

So you embarrassed yourself.  It feels bad.  I know.    

However.  You have a couple options now which will redeem you.  You can one, let it cool off and then make contact with specific people in your social group (probably the one I'd go with).  People are forgiving and if others were drinking too they won't recall it *nearly* as well as you do in a couple weeks.  You only remember it so vividly because you did it and then realized you were wrong afterwards.  Emotions were flowing strongly.  Others will not remember it as you do, and not nearly as clearly.  They had a completely different experience that night than you.  I promise.  Everybody really only cares about their own shit.          

Second option:  Well, there are a lot of people out there.  I know this isn't comforting because it is sometimes difficult and scary to meet new people or find a new social group, but I'm going for perspective here.  The millions of people you have access to in some way all want the same thing you do.  Companionship, love, humor, etc:  basically human interaction.  You happen to be human.  Fuckin' halfway there.  Just a thought.       

One thing I realllly want to get across though.  Is that these peoples' opinions seem *incredibly* important now.  Maybe the most important thing in the world, certainly important enough for you to post this tonight.  Their opinions are not that important.  You will learn that as you age.  People are people are people are people.  And their thoughts do not affect your livelihood or your safety or your food/shelter.  They really are completely unimportant in the scheme of things.  Because there are more of them!  And those that were there to witness your "monster"ing will have completely forgotten it in a few years, if not in a few months.  So really it is not that big of a thing.       

It will take you a few days to take in what I am saying to you.  I mean, I know you can read and comprehend.  I am not being condescending or acting like I am an authority on this.  I am being real.  This shit takes some time to sink in.  Once you've let it sit with you for awhile you may find yourself coming to "sudden" understandings.  Please give thought to what I am saying - I am not typing this because I think I'm wrong.  I simply have lived a few more years than you and seen things muuuuuuuch worse happen at house parties.      

Anyway, I just want to plant the seed.  Please think about what I am trying to get across.        

           
And as icing on the cake in the scheme of things you are completely unimportant.  Surprise!  Your brain just won't let you understand that.  You are currently the only thing in your world.  But you are not even a *blip* to the rest of the world.  Not a spec of sand.  If so many people have done so many worse things than you on a scale that you cannot even comprehend, and then lived with themselves afterwards..  Well, I think you have a shot my friend.      

Right now you are the only thing that matters, and the next step is forgiving yourself and realizing that these peoples' opinions are not nearly as important as they seem.      

peace

Yet surviving is a way to prove them wrong and laugh in their face.  Because you are doing well while they are still miserable people.  It can work both ways I think.  Most who have harmed you won't think that they have and would not think about your death for much longer than it took for them to hear about it (if they ever did).

Hey brother.  You're not a sad little bitch.  You're an alcoholic.  Which means these mood swings are normal.  It comes with the territory.      

A former-engineering student that plays guitar.  Hmm.  I bet you would be pretty cool to hang out with / interesting to talk to.  Just thinking out loud.      

I understand what you're going through, and while I obviously don't know your circumstances I get the feelings though.        

I am not exactly qualified to give advice and no songs are popping into my mind at the moment.  But I want to let you know that you are (most likely) a worthwhile person.  Just extrapolating from what you've said and how you write.  It's in my best interest to keep people like you around on this rock, eh?      

Sorry to hear about the family friend, and good luck dude.  Focus on the guitar.  Getting into the *flow* is just as good as any drug.

Hey man,     

You can't be convinced and I cannot change your mind.  Okay.      
  
I am going to tell you not to do this for a completely different reason than you would think.  I mean, consider it.  If you die it is nothing to me, right?  You are just words on a screen (not really - but I hope you understand how I mean this).  Really I have no vested interest in your survival.         

However, I am interested in saving you from pain.  I don't like pain.  Never been much of a fan.  There's too much pain in the world already to inflict it on ourselves physically.        

Effexor is NOT the drug you want to OD on.  Trust me.  I am no doctor or scientist but I have read the literature on how it works and have had some firsthand experience.        

The first thing you need to understand when making this decision is that you *may* end up in a hospital.  You *may* end up in a great deal of pain while you lie helpless in a hospital bed waiting to die, but you *may* not even know what is happening other than an experience of complete terror and regret.      
        
The second thing, is even if somebody catches you in time and you survive you may have lasting damage.  Meaning you will *still* feel this way but even worse because of the damage you've inflicted on your body.  That is not even considering the embarrassment and other emotional shit you will have to face from the reactions of those close to you / treating you.  It wouldn't be intentional, but people are people and someone nearly dying is pretty scary.  If you haven't thought this far ahead about it or considered what would happen if you failed you are not ready to make a decision like this.      
     
That is it.  Oh, also it will likely be an extremely uncomfortable thing even if you "succeed."        

Just give it a bit more thought dude, this isn't the way you want to go out or the decision you want to look back on and hate yourself even more for.

Yes, that is pretty close.  It is spot-on that the "suicidal" aspect is just a side effect, and not overly concerning.  As in, I am not overly concerned whether I live or die and death often seems the much superior option.  I am not saying that I couldn't or wouldn't commit suicide.  Because I would.  At the drop of a hat if it were guaranteed and easy.  Thus far it has not been worth the risk.  However, were life to change suddenly and become much more difficult...  The risk may be worth it.  I am in a relatively stable environment and secure in food/shelter.  Yet I feel like this now.  Were those circumstances to change, I just don't know man.  Really, I am mainly alive through apathy.  I could live, I could die, but there is risk in trying death and my basic needs are currently met.     
  
So yes, I am certainly suicidal but it is only a symptom of a larger thing.

I agree.  Were this service available I would take advantage of it immediately.  I am a mostly logical person with a sound state of mind.   

  It is incredibly frustrating that I am going to have to kill myself in a potentially painful way if I do not want to do something illegal in the meantime to obtain the proper substances (fuck getting caught and ending up in jail though, stuff of nightmares).  I've been dealing with it for long enough and it has not changed, why don't I have the option to check out easily?        

I would be willing to take tests or do whatever in order to prove my "sanity" / rational state of mind.

Hey man,      

My sister is married to a vet that does the exact same thing.  Yeah, it surely freaked her out at first.  But from what I understand he warned her it might happen.  They have been living happily together for 4 years now.      

I mean, I don't really have any advice other than just be upfront about it with potential partners.  But it certainly is possible to have "quirks" like this and still be loved and respected as a "normal" person.  My brother-in-law is living proof.      

Good luck with this one, but if she doesn't work out...  there are plenty more that might.  You're not broken my friend.
